verdict.rationale: Zamzar's docs include example requests that run against a dedicated sandbox endpoint, and it advertises fully tested code samples, so copy-and-run examples exist. Nothing shows an interactive, in-browser API explorer, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec that would typically power one. Missing for 10: interactive in-browser API reference or try-it console, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the examples run as documented.
